title: Choose Ali’s portfolio visual world
question: A replacement visual world is ready. Keep the assigned direction, take an alternate, or re-roll it with a short steer.

options.label: The Calibration Ledger
options.lineage: precision instrument panels, commissioning certificates, and engineers’ field records
options.thesis: A portfolio read as an instrument of evidence: measured, durable, and immediately legible.
options.viewport: Ali’s name occupies the upper field; role, city, and three verified evidence points lock into a calibrated lower register beside a direct resume contact path.
options.risk: It must stay editorial and human, or evidence notation can become a sterile dashboard.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.lineage: mid-century laboratory counters and visible numerical apparatus
options.thesis: Professional evidence is shown as a small bank of physical, changing readings.
options.case: Partial fit: the instrument grammar matches systems work, but literal glowing digits risk DevOps cosplay and may outshine the actual work.

options.label: Rain-Dark City Grid
options.lineage: urban nocturne, public infrastructure maps, and blue-hour transit systems
options.thesis: Platform work is framed as calm, dependable infrastructure quietly holding a city together.
options.case: Audience recognition is strong, but it fuses poorly because scenic atmosphere would dilute the factual evidence recruiters need.

options.label: Hand-Drawn Technical Zine
options.lineage: annotated engineering zines, whiteboard diagrams, and friendly explainers
options.thesis: Complex systems are made approachable through direct annotation and visual explanation.
options.case: Product clarity survives, but it fuses poorly with the desired professional status and would make this portfolio feel less senior.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A high-craft conventional engineering portfolio: dark shell, simple hero, project cards, and standard chronology.
canonCard.viewport: A clear headline, role summary, and featured projects in the arrangement visitors already expect.
